name: a4_t2_gate
setup: set -e; pip install -q numpy tokenizers matplotlib transformers==4.51.3; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; python -m babylm.data.prepare --download --splits train_10M,dev; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm; if [ -n "${RESTORE_URI:-}" ]; then mkdir -p babylm/runs; gsutil -m -q rsync -r "$RESTORE_URI" babylm/runs; fi; python -m babylm.moonshot.mini_ruler --sizes 1; python -c "from babylm.data import corpus as C; m = C.load_split('train_1M').meta; want = {'words': 1001443, 'tokens': 1601735, 'sha256': 'c6acf2aaeebd793986ddd5dfb4783f5cef7aeb01ec636306c9f782d56888cd83', 'parent_sha256': '30be8c16ad4b2147d6c09d63f9463f2222313cd87a0e7ea11084084b0d74cfe4'}; got = {k: m[k] for k in want}; assert got == want, ('train_1M differs from the committed subset', got)"; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_twin_ref-0026.py babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py

jobs.name: a4_t2g_generate
jobs.cmd: mkdir -p babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/gen; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/gen/t2.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.generate --ckpt babylm/runs/a4_t2g_G/resume.pt --out babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/gen/t2 --seed_split train_1M --block_split train_1M --words 10000000; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/gen/probe.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.generate --ckpt babylm/runs/a4_t2g_G/resume.pt --out babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/gen/probe --seed_split train_1M --rows 2000; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/gen/n1.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.generate --ckpt babylm/runs/a4_t2g_G/resume.pt --out babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/gen/n1 --selfseed --block_split train_1M --words 10000000

jobs.name: a4_t2g_build
jobs.cmd: [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/syn_t2/bin/synth.meta.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.data build babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/syn_t2 babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/gen/t2.jsonl.gz --words 10000000; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/syn_n1/bin/synth.meta.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.data build babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/syn_n1 babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/gen/n1.jsonl.gz --words 10000000; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/syn_n2/bin/synth.meta.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.data shuffle babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/syn_t2 babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/syn_n2

jobs.name: a4_t2g_audit
jobs.cmd: mkdir -p babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/audit; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/audit/leak.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.audit leak babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/syn_t2 babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/syn_n1 babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/syn_n2 --eval_dir /opt/babylm/osf/evaluation_data --out babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/audit/leak.json; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/audit/copy_t2.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.audit copy babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/syn_t2 --probe babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/gen/probe.jsonl.gz --out babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/audit/copy_t2.json; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/audit/copy_n1.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.audit copy babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/syn_n1 --probe babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/gen/probe.jsonl.gz --out babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/audit/copy_n1.json

jobs.name: a4_t2g
jobs.cmd: python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_a4_t2.json --only a4_t2g --device cuda; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2g/result.json ] && { { [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2g/score/score.json ] || bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/a4_t2g /opt/babylm; }; [ -d babylm/runs/a4_t2g/score/hf ] && { [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2g/score/dev_bpw_twin.json ] || /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py babylm/runs/a4_t2g/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --slice full --ws collapse --line_join newline --out babylm/runs/a4_t2g/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/a4_t2g/score/dev_bpw_twin.log 2>&1 || echo '[twin] a4_t2g failed'; }; python -m babylm.a4.t2 twin babylm/runs/a4_t2g; }

jobs.name: a4_t2g_report
jobs.cmd: mkdir -p babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/plots; for r in a4_t2g_G a4_t2g_base a4_t2g_M a4_t2g a4_t2g_n0 a4_t2g_n1 a4_t2g_n2; do [ -f babylm/runs/$r/curves.csv ] && python -m babylm.harness.plot_curves babylm/runs/$r; done; python -m babylm.harness.plot_curves babylm/runs/a4_t2g_G babylm/runs/a4_t2g_base babylm/runs/a4_t2g_M babylm/runs/a4_t2g babylm/runs/a4_t2g_n0 babylm/runs/a4_t2g_n1 babylm/runs/a4_t2g_n2 --out babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/plots/all; python -m babylm.a4.ledger babylm/runs/a4_t2g babylm/runs/a4_t2g_n0 babylm/runs/a4_t2g_n1 babylm/runs/a4_t2g_n2 --base_result babylm/runs/a4_t2g_base/result.json --out babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/ledger.json; python -m babylm.a4.t2 gate --runs_root babylm/runs --data babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data --oracle_dev 5.002263348908206 --out babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/gate.json || true

note: A4 T2 arm: closed-system augmentation (official FAQ), outside R0.2; never a strict-small entry; pool: moonshot. Mini-ruler T2 gate at the 1M scale (labels only; base job base_S_wd0p4_lr0p5_r1_ve0_tied from ref-0065:babylm/configs/jobs_base_r1_S.json): one A100, sequential, about 1.2 h (scoring dominates): maxdur 2 h. Preempted => relaunch the same file with env RESTORE_URI=<bucket>/vms/<old VM>/out/babylm/runs (every step skips what exists). Afterwards copy each run's small files (result.json, config.json, curves.csv, train_log.csv, log.jsonl, *.png, score/*.json incl. dev_bpw_twin.json) and babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/{audit,plots,ledger.*,gate*} and babylm/runs/a4_t2g_data/gen/*.json to shared/babylm/attacks/A4/t2/<run>/; keep the run dirs (G's resume.pt) in GCS; tell the A4 thread (it reads the audits first, then the verdict).
